name: Math
description: Evaluates math expressions and converts units exactly: arithmetic, powers, roots, trigonometry, logarithms in any base, factorials, combinations, minimum and maximum, and units of length, mass, temperature, data, speed and more. Use when an answer needs a calculation or a unit conversion.

functions.name: math_evaluate
functions.description: Evaluate a math expression. Supports + - * / % ^, parentheses, n! (factorial), pi, e, sqrt, cbrt, abs, floor, ceil, round, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan (radians), ln, log10, log2, log(x, base), exp, min(a, b, ...), max(a, b, ...), factorial(n), nCr(n, r) and nPr(n, r). Numbers are 64-bit floats, about 15 significant digits.

precision.description: Digits after the decimal point in 'formatted'

functions.name: math_convert
functions.description: Convert a value between units of the same quantity: length, mass, time, area, volume, speed, data (kB is 1000 bytes, KiB is 1024), energy, power, pressure, angle and temperature. Accepts symbols and names, such as km, mi, kg, lb, C, F, GiB, mph, kWh. US gallons, pints and cups unless imp_gal or imp_pt is given. A year is 365.25 days.

from.description: The unit the value is in
